mapper.select: select account_id as accountId, available_amount as availableAmount, frozen_amount as frozenAmount, version, account_status as accountStatus from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and account_type = #{accountType} and is_delete = 0 limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account (tenant_id, member_id, account_type, available_amount, frozen_amount, account_status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{accountType}, 0.00, 0.00, 1, 0, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account set available_amount = #{availableAmount}, frozen_amount = #{frozenAmount}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where account_id = #{accountId} and version = #{version} and account_status = 1 and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select direction, amount, ledger_status as ledgerStatus from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_deposit_ledger where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and ref_type = 'market_post' and ref_id = #{postId} and is_delete = 0 order by deposit_ledger_id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger (tenant_id, member_id, account_type, ledger_no, direction, biz_type, amount, balance_after, ref_type, ref_id, pay_channel, pay_order_no, ledger_status, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{accountType}, #{ledgerNo}, #{direction}, #{bizType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{payChannel}, #{payOrderNo}, 1, #{operatorId}, now(), #{remark}, 0)

insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_market_deposit_ledger (tenant_id, member_id, amount, direction, ref_type, ref_id, ledger_status, idempotency_key, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{amount}, #{direction}, #{refType}, #{refId}, 1, #{idempotencyKey}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{remark}, 0)
